messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected on /v1/generate in us-west-2. Error spike started ~T-3m. 5xx type: runtime crashes / SIGSEGV and OOMs observed on model-runner pool. Mean latency up 2x. Threshold breached: 5xx > 2% for 1m. Link: https://telemetry.internal/alerts/6135792468
Amy (oncall): acked. pulling logs and starting triage. Paging Jin and Ryan. Any immediate mitigations? :pager:
Jin (eng-sre): on it. I'm seeing repeated node restarts in runner-set-a: container crashloop with exit code 139 (segfault) and kernel OOM messages pointing to tcmalloc allocations. stack: 
```
#0 0x7f9a1b2c in llm::forward(...)
#1 0x7f9a10d0 in model::run_step(...)
#2 0x400abc in main_loop
```
Also GPU watchdog resets on node gpu-23.
Ryan (eng-runtime): suspecting attention-kernel regression in recent runtime push (r2026.3.7). Maria, any model changes rolled?
Maria (eng-ml): No model changes in prod. We've been experimenting with denser KV caching in staging but not promoted. This looks like a driver/kernel interaction with long sequences + quant path. Running quick repro on staging with sequence len 4096.
Amy (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) throttle/route traffic away from runner-set-a to runner-set-b (if capacity) 2) enable fallback model variant with smaller memory footprint 3) temporarily disable per-request dynamic batching to reduce peak memory. I'll start routing now.
Ryan (eng-runtime): doing a gradual route swap now via routing-service: `POST /v1/routes/shift` payload -> set weight runner-set-a:10, runner-set-b:90. watching metrics.
Amy (oncall): route change in progress. Latency on edge held steady. 5xx rate dropping but still some residual errors (~0.8%).
Jin (eng-sre): spin up extra runner-set-b instances and set `oom_score_adj` stricter. Also increasing node eviction pressure threshold. K8s commands: 
```bash
kubectl scale deployment/runner-set-b --replicas=20 -n inference
kubectl annotate pod runner-set-a-xxx mitigation=true
```
Ryan (eng-runtime): disabling quantized fast-path on the live config for affected model family: `PATCH /internal/configs/models/llama-40b` set `fast_quant_path=false`. Applying now.
Maria (eng-ml): staging repro with seq4096 hit same segfault in quant path. Disabling quant path removes crash in staging. Good find.
Liz (customer-success): FYI CS: accounts with high-throughput streaming calls (customer: AtlasData) saw 12% error rate peak; they reached out via support at T+4m. I'm on the call. Customers flagged: AtlasData, FinPrompt, ChatFlow. All on us-west-2. No PII exposure; failures are 5xx truncation/crash responses.
Amy (oncall): remaining action items: - paged infra owners to monitor node reboots - Ryan to push hotfix that disables regression and include fallback binary - Jin to prepare postmortem template and customer impact notes - Maria to add test repro case to CI for seq>=4k
Ryan (eng-runtime): building hotfix branch r2026.3.7-hotfix-noquant; will push canary to runner-set-a with crash-protection flags and reduced batch_size=1. Command: `image push redwood/runtime:r2026.3.7-hotfix-noquant && deploy canary --subset runner-set-a --count 2`
Jin (eng-sre): logs show memory pressure dropping after reroute + disable quant path. No new OOMs in last 3m. I'll keep autoscaler at aggressive to soak traffic.
Amy (oncall): incident-bot: create incident record INC-2026-0613-01, assign SLO impact tag and link this thread. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0613-01 created by Amy (oncall). Severity: Sev2 (customer-facing errors, partial outage). Pager schedule updated, next: Amy -> Jin handoff at T+55m.
Liz (customer-success): I sent a templated status update to affected customers: "We're investigating elevated 5xx on inference in us-west-2; mitigation in progress; engineering working on fix; ETA 1h. Will update in 15m." They acknowledged.
Ryan (eng-runtime): canary deployed to 2 nodes in runner-set-a. Observability: canary serving non-quant code and batch_size=1. No segfaults observed in canary logs after 2m.
Amy (oncall): good. I'm marking active mitigation successful. 5xx rate now ~0.12% back within SLO. Keeping incident open for postmortem and follow-ups. Handoff to Jin for longer-term cleanup and RCA.
Jin (eng-sre): taking over. Notes: collect core dumps + kernel logs from affected nodes (/var/log/messages, dmesg), preserve nodes for postmortem, and run extended soak tests with seq 4k+ on debug builds. I'll file the RCA tracking ticket and coordinate with Driver team.
Maria (eng-ml): I'll add a regression test for quant fast-path into CI and add gating for runtime version checks. Also adding a perf/mem trace on seq 2k/4k during nightly runs.
Liz (customer-success): I'll follow up customers with post-incident note when we have root cause and ETA for full fix.
Amy (oncall): thanks all. final note: don't delete runner-set-a nodes yet — Jin wants cores. We'll reconvene on postmortem in 24h. :v:
